Name: BUDGET_PARAM_ST
Description: Limits for the developer budget monitor (an on-screen memory meter). The row is chosen by the current map block when the player enters it (−1: none). Each value is the full-bar limit of one meter category; usage above 90% is flagged. Nothing is capped and no gameplay effect was found. Units are presumably MB (retail: 3000 total).

Fields.Description: Budget monitor limit: all VRAM. Presumably MB.
